blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — A priest and environmental advocate of the Calapan City Diocese urged authorities to pause plans to dredge the Alag–Longos River System in Baco town and address first the project’s far-reaching impacts on coastal communities and entire ecosystems. “Reducing flooding is a legitimate goal — but it should not come at the cost of coastal communities, fisheries, and the very environment that sustains them,” argued Fr. Edwin Gariguez, Executive Director of the Diocesan Social Action Center of the Diocese of Calapan, in a social media post. Gariguez said the Alag and Longos Rivers are not isolated waterways […]...
